Name: }bedrock.migrate.file

Parameters.Name: pFile
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: File path in the source file storage, with '/' between folders

Parameters.Name: pTargetPath
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Target file path. Ends with '/' = folder (keeps file name). Starts with '/' = from storage root, otherwise relative to pFile's folder (Default = pFile)

Parameters.Name: pDeleteSourceFile
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Delete the source file after a successful copy (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pSourceConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Source connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it

Parameters.Name: pTargetConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Target connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it. If blank, the source connection is used

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.

Parameters.Name: pChunkSize
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Chunk size in bytes when pMultiPartUpload = 1 (Default = 104857600, i.e. 100 MB)

Parameters.Name: pMultiPartUpload
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Transfer the file in chunks of pChunkSize bytes, for large files (Boolean. Default = 0)
